grupo do 1º prêmio, telemetria, injeção de dependências e ranking experimental.

Não executa deploy, commit ou alteração de pesos.

   02813 | function layerProbability(freqMap, samples, alpha = TOP3_SMOOTH_ALPHA) {
   02814 |   const out = new Map();
>> 02815 |   const k = safeInt(TOP3_GROUPS_K, 25);
   02816 |   const a = Math.max(0, Number(alpha || 0));
   02817 |   const base = Math.max(0, Number(samples || 0));
   02818 |   const denom = Math.max(1, base + (a * k));
   02819 | 
   02820 |   for (let g = 1; g <= k; g += 1) {
   02821 |     const count = Math.max(0, Number(freqMap?.get?.(g) || 0));
   02822 |     out.set(g, (count + a) / denom);
   02823 |   }
   02824 | 
   02825 |   return out;
   02826 | }

   00035 | async function mapWithConcurrency(items, concurrency, mapper) {
   00036 |   const arr = Array.isArray(items) ? items : [];
   00037 |   const out = new Array(arr.length);
   00038 |   let index = 0;
   00039 | 
   00040 |   async function worker() {
   00041 |     while (index < arr.length) {
   00042 |       const i = index++;
   00043 |       out[i] = await mapper(arr[i], i);
   00044 |     }
   00045 |   }
   00046 | 
   00047 |   await Promise.all(
   00048 |     Array.from({ length: Math.min(concurrency, arr.length) }, worker)
   00049 |   );
   00050 | 
   00051 |   return out;
   00052 | }

   02839 | function incMap(map, key, value = 1) {
   02840 |   const k = Number(key);
>> 02841 |   if (!Number.isFinite(k) || k < 1 || k > TOP3_GROUPS_K) return;
   02842 |   map.set(k, Number(map.get(k) || 0) + Number(value || 0));

   02859 | function layerProbability(freqMap, samples, alpha = TOP3_SMOOTH_ALPHA) {
   02860 |   const out = new Map();
>> 02861 |   const k = safeInt(TOP3_GROUPS_K, 25);
   02862 |   const a = Math.max(0, Number(alpha || 0));
   02863 |   const base = Math.max(0, Number(samples || 0));
   02864 |   const denom = Math.max(1, base + (a * k));
   02865 | 
   02866 |   for (let g = 1; g <= k; g += 1) {
   02867 |     const count = Math.max(0, Number(freqMap?.get?.(g) || 0));
   02868 |     out.set(g, (count + a) / denom);
   02869 |   }
   02870 | 
   02871 |   return out;
   02872 | }

   02874 | function sampleConfidence(samples, fullAt = 30) {

   02877 |   return Math.max(0, Math.min(1, n / lim));
   02878 | }

   02839 | function incMap(map, key, value = 1) {
   02840 |   const k = Number(key);
>> 02841 |   if (!Number.isFinite(k) || k < 1 || k > TOP3_GROUPS_K) return;
   02842 |   map.set(k, Number(map.get(k) || 0) + Number(value || 0));
   02843 | }
   02844 | 
>> 02845 | function emptyGroupMap() {
   02846 |   const out = new Map();
>> 02847 |   for (let g = 1; g <= safeInt(TOP3_GROUPS_K, 25); g += 1) out.set(g, 0);
   02848 |   return out;
   02849 | }
   02850 | 
>> 02851 | function getTop5GroupSet(draw) {
   02852 |   return new Set(
>> 02853 |     getAllTop5Groups(draw)
>> 02854 |       .map((x) => Number(x.grupo))
>> 02855 |       .filter((g) => Number.isFinite(g) && g >= 1 && g <= TOP3_GROUPS_K)
   02856 |   );
   02857 | }
   02858 | 
   02859 | function layerProbability(freqMap, samples, alpha = TOP3_SMOOTH_ALPHA) {
   02860 |   const out = new Map();
>> 02861 |   const k = safeInt(TOP3_GROUPS_K, 25);
   02862 |   const a = Math.max(0, Number(alpha || 0));
   02863 |   const base = Math.max(0, Number(samples || 0));
   02864 |   const denom = Math.max(1, base + (a * k));
   02865 | 
   02866 |   for (let g = 1; g <= k; g += 1) {
   02867 |     const count = Math.max(0, Number(freqMap?.get?.(g) || 0));
   02868 |     out.set(g, (count + a) / denom);
   02869 |   }
   02870 | 
   02871 |   return out;
   02872 | }
   02873 | 
   02874 | function sampleConfidence(samples, fullAt = 30) {
   02875 |   const n = Number(samples || 0);
   02876 |   const lim = Math.max(1, Number(fullAt || 30));
   02877 |   return Math.max(0, Math.min(1, n / lim));
   02878 | }
